name: Iide (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Iide town emblem in white: two triangular peaks divided by a diagonal stroke, like a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Iide, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 September 1964.

features.role: Iide town emblem — two triangular peaks divided by a diagonal stroke, like a stylised mountain
